method: membrane-kv-runtime-relocate-probe 'failure' mode, cheap cases only (no OOM simulation on this constrained host, per instruction).

invalid_layer.note: layer=99999 on a 30-layer model -- relocate correctly returns false, layer 0 untouched, decode still works.

invalid_dev.note: dev=nullptr -- relocate correctly returns false, layer 0 untouched, decode still works.

source_eq_destination.note: Target device == current device -- NOT rejected by relocate_layer (it performs a harmless redundant relocation to a fresh buffer of the same buft). This is layer 0's FIRST relocation (CPU shared bulk -> CPU dedicated), not a second/repeated relocation, so it does not exercise the release_failure.json scenario.

duplicate_two_sequential_relocations.note: Two SEQUENTIAL (not concurrent -- Section 26 forbids concurrent calls) relocations of layer 0 (CPU->GPU then GPU->CPU). This DOES exercise the same free-on-second-relocation path documented as unsafe in release_failure.json. This particular run did not crash -- consistent with (not contradicting) the disclosed non-uniform manifestation described there; it is NOT treated as evidence the path is safe.

requirement_met: original layer remains valid and usable in all 4 cases -- no half-rebound state observed.
